data.command: python -c "import unittest; names=['test_fd027_wt_blackbox','test_fd029_wt_squash','test_fd030_conflict_recovery','test_fd030_worktree_blackbox','test_fd030_junction_cleanup']; suite=unittest.TestSuite(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName(n) for n in names); result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite); raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())"
data.scope: Five focused black-box test modules: tests/test_fd027_wt_blackbox.py, tests/test_fd029_wt_squash.py, tests/test_fd030_conflict_recovery.py, tests/test_fd030_worktree_blackbox.py, and tests/test_fd030_junction_cleanup.py.
data.expected_duration: Approximately 1-5 minutes; offline Go CLI build has a 180-second timeout, remaining Git/CLI operations are local.
data.side_effects: Creates and removes disposable Git repositories, worktrees, branches, Go cache, and a temporary executable under system temp or auto-cleaned .fd030-* directories within the FD worktree. No network, source edits, or retained distributable. An interrupted run may leave temporary directories.
data.risk_review: Inspected all five test modules, the invoked aiw-git dispatcher and FD worktree cleanup paths, and the aiw-fd CLI entry point. Tests isolate Git configuration and hooks, use temporary repositories, and perform destructive Git cleanup only inside those fixtures. Go module downloads and checksum networking are disabled; no production or current repository worktree path is passed as a fixture target.
